reason: Integrated the observation-only HardwareProfile capability into UX-ROM using documented Storage inventory and formatted PhysicalDisk providers, exact property support detection, five-second CIM timeouts, identifier redaction, monotonic bounded per-disk sampling, observer calibration, unique structured evidence, Layer 2 workflow routing, and the single full-diagnostics manifest. The final passive lab run completed 6 of 6 samples, identified one healthy 256 GB SK hynix SATA SSD without collecting its serial or unique ID, and measured 293.7735 ms median and 307.705 ms p95 query wall time. The idle window reported zero median latency and queue but is not a storage benchmark. No file workload or Windows setting changed and no bottleneck, upgrade, or performance-gain claim was made.
